items.title: DISHA
items.subtitle: Career Intelligence Transformation
items.description: DISHA is a career intelligence ecosystem engineered to modernize institutional placement operations. It replaces fragmented, manual processes with structured, data-centric workflows, transforming student data into transparent, scalable career pathways for Tier-2 and Tier-3 institutions.

items.title: SOLVIQ AI
items.subtitle: The Vanguard of Hiring Intelligence
items.description: Solviq AI is a skill-intelligent platform that designs personalized learning journeys and connects candidates to opportunities precisely when they achieve job-readiness. It aligns academic potential with corporate demand through predictive, data-driven intelligence.
